title: Yoke and Burdens
summary: A yoke was a wooden frame used to join animals for labor and became an image of submission, service, and burden.
background: Yoke language can describe oppression, discipleship, law, labor, or shared service. Jesus uses the image to call weary people to His gentle lordship.
teachingHelp: When teaching yoke imagery, clarify whether the passage speaks of oppression, obedience, or rest under Christ.
